CVE-2026-111497.why: Brotli decoder buffer overflow (c/dec/decode.c, 1.0.3 to 1.2.0). v2.3.3 and earlier: the immich and immich-api node processes map libbrotlidec 1.2.0 (nixpkgs node uses the shared library), and immich 3.2.4's Express 5 / body-parser 2.3.0, registered globally by NestFactory, inflates request bodies sent with Content-Encoding: br before any guard runs: a POST of br-labelled garbage to /api/auth/validateToken returns 500 where the plain request returns 401 (probed on hrossen 2026-11-07, locally on port 2283). Risk there: critical: one unauthenticated HTTP request from the internet (network:proxy allows home, netbird, internet) reaches the decoder in immich-api, which runs as the immich user with the database and every photo; upgrade. Fixed after v2.3.3 (commit 54f16aab): immich.nix swaps the pinned brotli for the same package built from 1.2.1 (system.replaceDependencies); on hrossen 2026-11-07 immich, immich-api and the machine-learning worker map libbrotlidec.so.1.2.1. 1.2.0 stays in the closure only through the base system (template nixpkgs rev 1f607aa79b63: systemd's curl 8.22.0, freetype/fontconfig, nix), which decodes br only in HTTP responses to what the guest itself fetches; no immich process maps it.

CVE-2026-86413.why: libcurl 8.22.0 (nixos-unstable) is loaded into immich and immich-api only as a dependency of libvips' poppler and cfitsio loaders. poppler uses curl only to open a document by http(s) URL and libvips passes it bytes; cfitsio only when the file name is a URL, and immich passes its own upload paths. PDF and FITS are not accepted upload types; immich's own HTTP goes through Node. The system services (nix-daemon, NetworkManager) use the stable curl. Checked live on hrossen 2026-11-07.

CVE-2026-0861.why: memalign alignment overflow in glibc 2.30 to 2.42 (the CVE's own text); NVD's range has no upper bound, and immich's glibc 2.44 carries the fix.

CVE-2026-19499.why: strfmon width padding overflow, real in glibc 2.44; only reachable if a program calls strfmon with right-justified padding — immich's Node and Python services do not. Kept counted as glibc is.

CVE-2019-1010022.why: Disputed upstream (a stack-guard bypass that needs an existing overflow); the record names no affected versions. Kept counted as glibc is.

CVE-2019-1010023.why: Disputed upstream (ldd on a malicious ELF, treated by glibc as a non-security bug); the record names no affected versions. Kept counted as glibc is.

CVE-2014-9826.why: SUN coder error handling fixed in ImageMagick 6.8.9 (2014); 7.1.2-31 contains the fix, the match comes from a version-less CVE record.

CVE-2017-5506.why: Double free in profile.c fixed in 6.9.7-4 / 7.0.4-4; 7.1.2-31 contains the fix.

CVE-2026-108693.why: NTGhostscriptEXE() launching gswin64c.exe by bare name is Windows-only code; the immich VM runs Linux, where ImageMagick calls the gs binary from its own store path.

CVE-2026-106565.why: Missing end-of-file check reading bzip2-compressed blob data (MagickCore/blob.c), an endless loop; fixed in 7.1.2-32. immich-api loads this ImageMagick through libvips (no VIPS_BLOCK_UNTRUSTED), which picks a loader by content, so a crafted upload from a signed-in user can reach it. Risk here: low: one media job spins, no memory corruption. Fix: an unstableSrc with imagemagick 7.1.2-32 or later (nixos-unstable has 7.1.2-34).

CVE-2026-106567.why: PSD decoder integer-conversion loop on 32-bit builds only; the immich VM runs the x86_64 build.

CVE-2026-96611.why: Signed integer overflow in the MOV/MP4 demuxer's HEIF ispe box: immich probes (ffprobe) and transcodes every uploaded video, and immich is published to the internet — reachable by any user with a login, as the immich user. Not in FFmpeg 8.1.3 (fixed upstream in 059eb2e, FFmpeg 9.0); jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-2 runs here (#807).

CVE-2026-52297.why: Out-of-bounds read from unpadded IAMF extradata in the MOV demuxer (mov_read_iacb): immich probes (ffprobe) and transcodes every uploaded video, and immich is published to the internet — reachable by any user with a login, as the immich user. A read past a buffer, not a write. Not in FFmpeg 8.1.3 (fixed upstream in 8439e02, FFmpeg 9.0).

CVE-2026-52296.why: The WMA encoder (libavcodec/wmaenc.c); immich encodes audio only as AAC or Opus, never WMA.

CVE-2026-107696.why: The RTSP client; immich gives ffmpeg uploaded local files only, and ffmpeg's protocol whitelist for a file input does not open rtsp.

CVE-2026-70628.why: DVB subtitle parser signed overflow (libavcodec/dvbsub_parser.c): fixed in FFmpeg 8.1.3, which jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-2 is built on — 46ef25c9c, cherry-picked from 93f2a525e. NVD's range (before 9.0) misses the 8.1 backport.

CVE-2026-70632.why: CineForm HD transform-2 out-of-bounds write (libavcodec/cfhd.c): fixed in FFmpeg 8.1.3, which jellyfin-ffmpeg 8.1.3-2 is built on — ea7210860, cherry-picked from db05df9d1. NVD's range (before 9.0) misses the 8.1 backport.

CVE-2026-20884.why: deflate_dng_load_raw integer overflow (TALOS-2026-2364) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit aa4458e, Debian marks 0.22.1-1 fixed); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-24450.why: uncompressed_fp_dng_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2363) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit c911c9b); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-20911.why: HuffTable::initval overflow (TALOS-2026-2330) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 5357bb5); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-21413.why: lossless_jpeg_load_raw overflow (TALOS-2026-2331) is fixed in upstream LibRaw 0.22.1 (commit 75ed2c1); the shipped libraw is 0.22.1.

CVE-2026-59850.why: libssh is linked only into ffmpeg (jellyfin-ffmpeg, opencv's ffmpeg) for the sftp:// protocol; Immich hands ffmpeg local file paths only and never connects to an SSH server, so the channel callback path never runs.

CVE-2026-54873.why: QUIC stack packet-buffer retention; nothing on the immich VM uses OpenSSL's QUIC stack (immich-server and the ML service speak plain HTTP, outbound HTTPS from Node is TCP TLS).

CVE-2026-72897.why: Needs a TLS server that swaps SSL_CTX mid-handshake with differing provider sigalgs; no process on the immich VM serves TLS with this OpenSSL (TLS ends at the firewall's Caddy, :2283 is plain HTTP).

CVE-2026-84782.why: DTLS retransmission bug; nothing on the immich VM speaks DTLS.

CVE-2026-84784.why: QUIC NEW_CONNECTION_ID flood; nothing on the immich VM uses OpenSSL's QUIC stack.

CVE-2022-0543.why: Debian/Ubuntu packaging bug (Lua loaded as a dynamic library, exposing package/loadlib); nixpkgs builds redis with its bundled Lua and this Immich instance listens only on a unix socket.

CVE-2022-3734.why: Concerns an unofficial Windows port (dbghelp.dll search path); upstream Redis on Linux is not affected.
